exposure: Hysteroscopic lysis of severe intrauterine adhesions (IUAs)
outcome: Subendometrial blood flow (vascularization index (VI), flow index (FI), vascularization flow index (VFI))
cohort: Forty infertile women with severe IUAs participated in this study, serving as their own controls.
finding: Hysteroscopic lysis of severe IUAs significantly improves subendometrial blood flow and increases endometrial volume.
